key_insight: RecallRisk-BERT combines recall text and structured FDA metadata to predict both severity and root cause in one model, improving post-report recall triage.
clinical_relevance: This could help regulators and safety teams prioritize medical device recalls faster and more consistently after reports are filed.
method: Used 54,165 FDA medical device recall records from openFDA (2002 to Oct 2025).
Compared classical ML and boosting models with a PubMedBERT-based multi-task text-plus-tabular model.
Simultaneously predicted recall severity (Class I/II/III) and 9 consolidated root-cause categories.
evidence_signal: In single-task severity prediction, the LightGBM text-tabular model achieved 0.963 accuracy, 0.856 macro-F1, and 0.974 ROC-AUC; RecallRisk-BERT outperformed the single-task PubMedBERT baseline, with strong risk-ranking agreement (rho = 0.983).
watch_item: Results come from retrospective FDA records, so real-world deployment would still need external validation, monitoring for dataset shift, and careful handling of regulatory decision support.
paper_title: RecallRisk-BERT: A Multi-Task Framework for Post-Report Medical Device Recall Triage
